method: Ordinary point kriging on a separate simulation
packages: gstat::gstat; gstat::variogram; gstat::fit.variogram; gstat::krige; sf; terra; ggplot2
assumptions: 240 simulated point observations; stationary isotropic exponential covariance, constant unknown mean. Range selected from five candidates using training variogram SSE; training-only fit for buffered holdout. Final variogram refitted after assessment. Gaussian point support, including nugget variation. Conditional variance excludes fitted-parameter uncertainty. Pixel values are point predictions, not block means. Four workbook cores are not used. No AOI stock total or real-map accuracy is claimed.
